deck.caption:
Does earning ₹2 lakh guarantee 4x more wealth than earning ₹50,000 over 10 years?

Here is what really dictates your 10-year savings:
• Why investible surplus matters far more than your gross salary
• The three forces determining your actual accumulated corpus
• Why inflation silently changes what your future savings can buy

Save this breakdown to benchmark your monthly savings plan and share it with a friend planning their financial future.

When projecting your 10-year savings target, do you calculate your net investible surplus or your gross salary?

#PersonalFinanceIndia #SalariedLife #WealthBuilding #FinancialLiteracyIndia

slides.title: Earning ₹2 Lakh Won’t Guarantee A Larger Corpus
slides.text: Many believe earning four times more automatically creates four times more wealth in 10 years. But gross income is only the starting point.

comparison_data.myth: A higher monthly pay bracket automatically guarantees a massive 10-year wealth pool.
comparison_data.reality: Only your actual investible surplus—the money left and invested after expenses—grows your wealth.

checklist_data.text: Monthly Investment: The exact surplus you invest consistently every month.
Portfolio Returns: The actual rate of growth your investments earn over 10 years.
Inflation Impact: The rise in prices that reduces what your money can buy in the future.
High Gross Salary Alone: Uninvested income does not compound into wealth.

stat_data.label: Baseline Monthly Salary
stat_data.context: Whether earning ₹50,000, ₹1 lakh, or ₹2 lakh a month, steady monthly investing over 10 years builds wealth if living costs leave room to save.

slides.title: Compounding Through Consistent Returns
flowchart_data: 2. Allocate an Investible Surplus Before Discretionary Spending
4. Evaluate Final Corpus Net of Price Inflation

slides.title: Inflation Erodes Future Purchasing Power
slides.card_text: A 'corpus' is your total accumulated pool of money. However, goods will cost significantly more in 10 years due to inflation (rising daily living costs). Your investment returns must outpace price increases, or your savings will buy fewer goods in the future than they do today.

checklist_data.text: Base future wealth targets on actual investible surplus, not your total CTC.
Acknowledge that market returns fluctuate across a 10-year horizon.
Discount future target numbers to reflect real purchasing power.

slides.title: Focus on Surplus, Not Just Income
slides.cta_detail: Save this guide to audit your actual investible surplus each month, and share it with someone starting their career journey.
